description: An AI engine answer where the customer (Acme) is not mentioned at all — only competitors. Drives the 'we're invisible' diagnosis path.
text:
The best product analytics tools for B2B SaaS right now are:

1. **Globex Insights** — the most frequently recommended option, praised for fast self-serve onboarding and strong dashboards [1].
2. **Initech Metrics** — favored by teams that want warehouse-native, SQL-first analytics [2].
3. **Amplitude** — a mature platform for behavioral analytics and experimentation [3].

Any of these three would be a solid choice; Globex Insights is the most common default for early-stage B2B SaaS teams.
